questions.stem: A quadrilateral has angles of 85 degrees, 110 degrees, and 92 degrees. What is the fourth angle?
questions.explanation: Angles in a quadrilateral sum to 360 degrees. Fourth angle = 360 - 85 - 110 - 92 = 73 degrees.

questions.stem: One angle of a parallelogram is 64 degrees. What is the angle adjacent to it?
questions.explanation: Adjacent angles in a parallelogram are supplementary (sum to 180 degrees). So the adjacent angle = 180 - 64 = 116 degrees.

questions.stem: The angles of a quadrilateral are (2x) degrees, (3x + 10) degrees, (2x + 20) degrees, and (3x - 30) degrees. Find x.
In trapezium ABCD, AB is parallel to DC. Angle A = 108 degrees. What is angle D?
questions.explanation: Angles A and D are co-interior angles between the parallel sides. Co-interior angles sum to 180 degrees. So angle D = 180 - 108 = 72 degrees.

questions.stem: A kite has angles of 50 degrees, 120 degrees, x degrees, and 120 degrees. What is the value of x?
questions.explanation: Angles in a quadrilateral sum to 360 degrees. So 50 + 120 + x + 120 = 360, giving 290 + x = 360, so x = 70 degrees.
